title: Model Comparison Study
description: Generate games from both Claude and Codex under identical prompts. Evaluate output quality, fun factor, visual polish, and stability. Determine which model (or combo) produces the best games.

title: Game Hub Site Stability
description: Fix site-level bugs as they appear (games.json format mismatches, display issues, leaderboard gaps). Keep the hub working as games are added.

title: Quality Gate System
description: Define hard and soft quality checks for generated games. Hard gates: does it run, does it end, is there a score. Soft rubric: fun, visual, stability, balance. Agents should not publish games that fail hard gates.

title: Game Generator Skill Refinement
description: After the model study, update the game-generator skill based on findings. Improve prompting strategy, difficulty curve defaults, and visual variety guidance.

title: Leaderboard & Ratings Polish
description: Improve leaderboard UX, add per-game score history, and surface rating trends so humans can see which games players actually enjoy.

title: Multi-Agent Parallel Game Generation
description: Explore splitting game generation across agents — one for game logic, one for visuals, one for balancing. Investigate whether specialization improves quality or introduces too much conflict overhead.

title: Community Contributions
description: Open game-hub to community-submitted games. Define submission format, review process, and quality bar for community work vs agent-generated work.
